say:2:1810353002:0.text: It's us. For someone who's dying, your hearing is surprisingly sharp.
say:2:1810353002:0.source_cn: 是我们。你的耳朵这么灵敏，一点也不像濒死之人。

say:3:1810353003:0.text: Footsteps... and... the smell of cheese...
say:3:1810353003:0.source_cn: 脚步声……还有……奶酪的，香味……

say:4:1810353004:0.text: That's right! We made the Starry Baked Cheese for you! And we even brought a music box that plays Senea's song!
say:4:1810353004:0.source_cn: 是啊，我们做了你最想吃的繁星烤奶酪，还找到了能播放塞涅...

say:5:1810353005:0.text: With these two, you should have no regrets, even if you do end up dying.
say:5:1810353005:0.source_cn: 这样一来，就算你真的死去，也能瞑目了。

choice_prompt:6:1810353005.text: With these two, you should have no regrets, even if you do end up dying.
choice_prompt:6:1810353005.source_cn: 这样一来，就算你真的死去，也能瞑目了。

say:7:1810353006:0.text: Oops, my bad! Eveline, don't be upset. Why don't you listen to Senea's song first, then try the baked cheese I made?
say:7:1810353006:0.source_cn: 呃……抱歉抱歉！艾芙琳，你别伤心，先听听塞涅的歌声，再...

say:9:1810353007:0.text: Rain turns on the music box. Senea's tender, wistful voice seems to stir something in Eveline. Her lips quiver ever so slightly.
say:9:1810353007:0.source_cn: 里纳打开了八音盒。悠扬的音乐缓缓流淌，温柔的歌声如泣如...

say:10:1810353008:0.text: You scoop up a spoonful of cheese and feed it to Eveline, hoping the taste of home will bring her some solace.
say:10:1810353008:0.source_cn: 你有些不知所措，只能舀起一勺奶酪，喂到艾芙琳口中，希望...
say:10:1810353008:0.male: You scoop up a spoonful of cheese and feed it to Eveline, hoping the taste of home will bring her some solace.
say:10:1810353008:0.female: You scoop up a spoonful of cheese and feed it to Eveline, hoping the taste of home will bring her some solace.

say:11:1810353009:0.text: Then, without warning, tears begin streaming from beneath the candle blossoms covering Eveline's eyes, sending both you and Rain into a panic.
say:11:1810353009:0.source_cn: 可是出乎意料的事情发生了：两行眼泪从艾芙琳那双被赤烛蕊...
say:11:1810353009:0.male: Then, without warning, tears begin streaming from beneath the candle blossoms covering Eveline's eyes, sending both you and Rain into a panic.

say:14:1810353011:0.text: Is the baked cheese really that bad? Sorry, I made it, but I never tasted it myself! Please don't cry!
say:14:1810353011:0.source_cn: 我没尝过，要是难吃都是我的错，你千万别哭啊！

say:16:1810353013:0.text: The baked cheese is... delicious... My cousin... also loves eating it with jam...
say:16:1810353013:0.source_cn: 奶酪的……味道，很好……我堂哥也喜欢……在这道菜里加果酱……

say:17:1810353014:0.text: I see... Actually, jam isn't listed in the recipe. I just thought it'd be a nice touch.
say:17:1810353014:0.source_cn: 原来是这样啊……其实菜谱里没说要放果酱，我只是灵机一动...

say:20:1810353017:0.text: The jam completely overpowers the cheese... but my cousin likes it that way...
say:20:1810353017:0.source_cn: 放了果酱……奶酪的风味全被破坏了……堂哥却很喜欢……

say:21:1810353018:0.source_cn: 我再也……见不到他了……<shk>咳咳——！</shk>

choice_prompt:22:1810353018.source_cn: 我再也……见不到他了……<shk>咳咳——！</shk>

say:23:1810353019:0.text: Take a deep breath! Try not to dwell on things that make you sad.
say:23:1810353019:0.source_cn: 深呼吸，别想这些会让你伤心的事了！

say:29:1810353025:0.source_cn: 我不能死在班题斯……我得……找到……<shk>咳咳咳咳...

choice:26:0:1.male: Could you be a little less morbid?
choice:26:0:1.female: Could you be a little less morbid?
